baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_INVENTORY_AND_CONFIGURATION_DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md (FROZEN, 2026-09-20). Freshness and collection outcome are stated fields rather than implied ones, and a control must not advertise a capability the product does not have.
baseline.engineering: main at 58b5e84. The inventory screen now resolves a name, model and cluster reference for all 107 devices.
baseline.observed: Measured on the live deployment on 2026-09-20 after the device display fix landed. Of 107 enrolled devices, 60 have a last job in COMPLETED and 47 in FAILED, and every one of those 47 failed on connect_failed; 47 is also exactly the DRAFT count. The device detail states the reason plainly, down to the port and the elapsed timeout. The list row does not: it shows 'Registered, not confirmed' beside a warning triangle, so distinguishing a device the product can reach from one it cannot means opening each device in turn. Separately, the top app bar's search is not a search: TopAppBar.tsx renders a Box containing the literal text 'Search devices, settings, evidence' beside a search icon, with a pill radius and a surface colour that make it read as a field. There is no input element, no state and no handler. The inventory panel's own search is real and binds to searchTerm across hostname, device id, model, software version, cluster reference, management address and interface addresses, which is what makes the decorative one easy to mistake for working. The Draft filter chip is NOT defective: it is wired and its predicate is correct, and clicking it on the live deployment filters to the 47 unconfirmed devices. An earlier claim that it did nothing was withdrawn as a false finding; do not 'fix' it.

invariants: Collection failure is not a known-bad state: a device the product could not reach is unreached, not unhealthy, and the wording must not upgrade one into the other
Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence: never collected and failed to collect are different readings
A recorded job outcome is evidence; a reachability claim not backed by a recorded attempt is not, and none may be invented
Presentation identity is never a join key

recommended_reasoning.reason: A bounded presentation change against a frozen design contract, with the data already measured and the states named. No new vendor semantics and no collection behaviour.

requirements: The row states the last collection outcome using the reason already recorded on the job, never a reason derived, guessed or reworded into a claim the record does not make
A device whose last job failed is visibly distinguishable from one that has never been collected, and both from one that succeeded: three different states, three different readings
No device is hidden or filtered away by default because of its outcome
The reason shown is a safe class, not a raw transport string: no host, port-level detail, credential or address is introduced into the list row
The top app bar either performs a search or does not look like one; a styled box that ignores every keystroke is not an acceptable outcome
If the top bar is wired rather than removed, typing in it drives the same inventory filtering the panel search already performs, and the two do not hold separate contradictory states
risks: The terminal reason is a transport string and may carry detail that does not belong in a list row. Map it to a safe class rather than printing it; the detail pane already carries the full text for whoever needs it.
The design language forbids a coverage figure without a denominator, so a count of failures is stated against the total rather than as a bare number or a percentage.
Three states must stay distinguishable after the change: succeeded, failed, never collected. Collapsing the last two is the easy mistake here.
